description: This is an abstract PHP class defining the service layer for leave allocation in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for managing leave requests, checking overlaps, durations, shift lengths, and related utilities. It interfaces with other services and entities to handle leave logic within the HR system.

classes.name: AbstractLeaveAllocationService
classes.description: An abstract class that provides core functionalities for managing leave allocations, including overlap checks, duration calculations, shift length validations, and object generation for leave requests in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequest
methods.description: Abstract method to save a leave request and trigger notifications, implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Abstract method to determine the status of a leave request based on date and leave parameters.

methods.name: allowToExceedLeaveBalance
methods.description: Abstract method to specify if leave balance can be exceeded.

methods.name: getHashKeyForLeaveParamObject
methods.description: Generates a unique hash key for a given LeaveParameterObject to cache overlap leaves.

methods.name: getOverlapLeaves
methods.description: Retrieves overlapping leaves for a given leave request, considering multi-day and partial day options.

methods.name: hasOverlapLeaves
methods.description: Checks if there are any overlapping leaves for the specified leave parameters.

methods.name: isEmployeeAllowedToApply
methods.description: Checks if an employee is permitted to apply for a specific leave type.

methods.name: isWorkShiftLengthExceeded
methods.description: Verifies if the total work shift length exceeded with existing leaves for the employee on given dates.

methods.name: getWorkShiftLengthExceedOverlapLeaves
methods.description: Returns list of leaves that exceed work shift length during overlap periods.

methods.name: generateLeaveRequest
methods.description: Creates a LeaveRequest object from leave parameters.

methods.name: getWorkShiftDurationForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the work shift length for a given employee.

methods.name: getApplicableLeaveDuration
methods.description: Determines the applicable leave duration based on leave data and whether it is first or last day of multi-day leave.

methods.name: updateLeaveDurationParameters
methods.description: Updates leave object with duration and time parameters based on leave type and schedule.

methods.name: addHoursDuration
methods.description: Adds specified hours to a DateTime object, returning the new DateTime.

methods.name: getDurationInHours
methods.description: Calculates the difference in hours between two DateTime objects.

methods.name: createLeaveObjectListForAppliedRange
methods.description: Creates a list of Leave objects for each date in the application range based on leave parameters.

methods.name: isHalfDay
methods.description: Determines if a given day is a half-day leave based on schedule.

methods.name: isWeekend
methods.description: Checks if a date falls on a weekend according to employee schedule.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a date is a holiday for the employee.

methods.name: isHalfdayHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a date is a half-day holiday for the employee.
